name: text-text-pressure
title: Text Pressure
description: Ký tự gần con trỏ phình đậm và rộng ra, ký tự xa bị ép mảnh và hẹp lại, cả dòng vẫn giữ nguyên bề rộng như chịu áp lực.

moworks.author: moworks

options.period: s a sweep left → right → left (4), a cosine
options.reach: [min px, share of the line] of the falloff ([350, 0.45])
options.squeeze: [base, gain] of each letter's width (0.55 + 1.05 f)
options.cursor: a pointer drawn on the path (optional)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after react-bits (MIT + Commons Clause): written from the idea only, no react-bits code

moworks.notes: A cursor sweeps left ↔ right across the line as a cosine every 4 s (amplitude half the line width + 14 px, small vertical bob). Per char f = smoothstep(1 − |dx| / md), md = max(70 px, 0.45 × line width) (horizontal distance); wght = 100 + 800f; width factor 0.55 + 1.05f (source wdth 5–200; RFlex 25–151); then all widths are rescaled so the line keeps its rest width (far letters condense); min font size 24 px. Loop 4 s. Params: path: đường đi con trỏ (trái ↔ phải, 4 s) · wght (100–900) · wdth (hẹp ↔ rộng) · falloff: tầm ảnh hưởng (0.45 bề rộng dòng). f = smoothstep(1 − |dx| / reach) per letter; widths are then rescaled so the line keeps its rest width (far letters condense), and wdth follows each letter's share.
moworks.titleVi: Chữ phình theo con trỏ, giữ bề rộng
